user.title: Voice Broadcast
user.description:
This adds a push-to-talk card to your dashboards. You choose which speakers it can reach when you add the card.

Recording needs a secure connection. Open Home Assistant over HTTPS (Nabu Casa or your own certificate), otherwise your browser will block the microphone.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Voice Broadcast is already set up.

init.title: Voice Broadcast
init.description:
Speakers fetch recordings over HTTP, so they need an address they can reach themselves. The addresses come from Settings → System → Network; this only chooses which one to hand out.

Change this if your speakers cannot reach the internal address, which is common when Home Assistant sits behind a reverse proxy.
